beats.label: S1 · Eddie's mess
beats.text: Harrigan fixer Harry Da Souza cleans up after reckless heir Eddie stabs a clubgoer while partying with Tommy Stevenson, son of rival boss Richie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Harry's role and the incident that starts the war between the two families.

beats.label: S1 · Conrad kills Archie
beats.text: Matriarch Maeve names longtime advisor Archie as a police informant, and patriarch Conrad executes him on the spot as the Harrigans move on the Stevensons' fentanyl trade.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Maeve's willingness to frame allies and plants the mole thread that runs the whole season.

beats.label: S1 · Tommy's body found
beats.text: Harry tracks down club owner Valjon and uncovers Tommy Stevenson's mutilated corpse, confirming Eddie killed him and forcing the Harrigans to invent a cover.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The truth Harry now carries is what every subsequent Stevenson move hinges on.

beats.label: S1 · Valjon takes the fall
beats.text: Harry and Kevin coerce Valjon into confessing to Tommy's murder, and Richie forces Harry to execute him personally to prove Harrigan loyalty.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Buys the fragile truce that Maeve is about to shatter, and pulls Harry deeper into Richie's orbit.

beats.label: S1 · Vron bombed, war begins
beats.text: After the funeral truce, an enraged Maeve has Richie's wife Vron killed by car bomb, and the Harrigans move to the Cotswolds estate as open war begins.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment peace becomes impossible and the season pivots from cover-up to war.

beats.label: S1 · Maeve betrays Seraphina
beats.text: Maeve secretly offers daughter Seraphina to Richie to save her favoured Brendan; Richie takes both, and cartel boss Jaime executes Brendan on video before Harry can intervene.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Exposes Maeve as the family's true traitor and forces Harry to call in a favour from Kat McAllister that will define his future.

beats.label: S1 · Kevin takes the crown
beats.text: Conrad exposes Maeve as the mole, and both are arrested. Harry and Kevin ambush Richie's pub and kill him; Jan, breaking under it all, stabs Harry as Conrad is cheered in prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every power seat in the show has changed hands by the final frame — this is the state the next season inherits.

cliffhanger.text: The Stevensons are wiped out and Conrad and Maeve are behind bars, but Kevin is stepping into a throne he isn't ready for while Harry lies bleeding on his own kitchen floor, stabbed by his wife. Kat McAllister is circling with a power-sharing offer, and Conrad — cheered by his fellow inmates — is very much not finished.
questions: Does Harry survive Jan's attack, and if he does, where does his loyalty land?
Can Kevin actually hold the family together now that he knows Eddie is his son with Bella?
What does Kat McAllister want from the Harrigans, and what does Conrad plan from inside?

characters.name: Harry Da Souza
characters.line: The Harrigans' fixer — competent, loyal, and now stabbed by his own wife after being pulled into a favour he owes Kat McAllister.

characters.name: Kevin Harrigan
characters.line: Conrad's son and Eddie's nominal father; with his parents jailed, he has just declared himself the head of the family.

characters.name: Conrad Harrigan
characters.line: Imprisoned patriarch who killed Archie on Maeve's word and now holds court from a cell where the other inmates cheer him.

characters.name: Maeve Harrigan
characters.line: Conrad's wife, exposed at the end as the family's true police mole after engineering Vron's murder and selling out her daughter Seraphina.

characters.name: Bella Harrigan
characters.line: Kevin's wife, secretly Eddie's biological mother by Conrad, running her own political-blackmail scheme via her father Lord Pennock and the fixer Antoine.

characters.name: Eddie Harrigan
characters.line: The reckless grandson whose stabbing of Tommy Stevenson triggered the war; has just learned Conrad and Bella are his real parents.

characters.name: Jan Da Souza
characters.line: Harry's wife, worn down by his world and manipulated by both Conrad and undercover officer Alice; stabs Harry in the final scene.

characters.name: Seraphina Harrigan
characters.line: Conrad and Maeve's daughter — survived Amsterdam after Maeve sold her out, watched Brendan die, and now knows exactly what her mother is.

characters.name: Kat McAllister
characters.line: A rival power Harry has never met in person; brokered the Amsterdam rescue and has told Seraphina she wants a seat at the Harrigan table.

characters.name: Colin Tattersall
characters.line: Ex-organised-crime officer who was Richie's inside man all along; murdered DS Fisk and handed Alice over to the Stevensons before their fall.
